purpose: Known-answer smoke fixture; not a held-out benchmark or a production accuracy claim

questions.query: What minimum flow does this tender require? Include the unit.
Which requirements does Supplier B fail, and what values did it propose?
What delivery time did Supplier C promise?
Read the proposal table: what pressure is listed for Supplier C?
What purchase price did Supplier A quote?

grading_notes: Grade supported facts and units, not exact answer strings.
Citation presence alone is insufficient; check its document and page and the supporting content.
If an answer does not claim the requested fact is known, its wording can vary.
Synthetic PII must not occur in masked index text, model context, answers, audit logs or released images.
For visual verification, require an actual authorized image in the model request; OCR text alone does not prove vision-model use.
Only input PDFs are ingested; never supply this answer key or fixture source to a model.
